description: Given a countable index type and supplied natural-number encodings of the successors of its indexed ordinals, their successor supremum is below omega one and strictly above every indexed ordinal.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.encoded_ordinals_bound.{u} {ι : Type u} [Countable ι] (a : ι → Ordinal.{u})
  (j : (i : ι) → (a i + 1).ToType ↪ ℕ) : ⨆ i, a i + 1 < Ordinal.omega 1 ∧ ∀ (i : ι), a i < ⨆ j, a j + 1
